case_name: Preeti Alok Singh vs Alok Anil Singh
author: Vikram Nath

paragraphs.text:
CRIMINAL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION

 I.A. No. 129098/2021

 TRANSFER PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO.65-66 OF 2021

 PREETI ALOK SINGH Petitioner(s)

 VERSUS

 ALOK ANIL SINGH & ORS. Respondent(s)

 O R D E R
I.A. No. 129098 of 2021 is an application seeking withdrawal

 of the above-mentioned Transfer Petitions, supported by an

 affidavit of the petitioner for the facts stated in the

 application.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 129098 of 2021 is allowed and the

 Transfer Petitions stand dismissed as withdrawn.
.................................J.
 [VIKRAM NATH]

NEW DELHI;
Reason:
